title: GHOST GRADE
body: You refused every applicant who looked like the pattern you had in your head. The gap on the page. The changed surname. The uneven lighting.
Every one of those had an answer, and the answer was in the application you did not open.
You lost to the distractors before the synthetics even had to try.
couldHaveDone: Use the resolving tool before the stamp. A career gap is a question, not a verdict - the letter said so every time.
